journal.text: Initial $50k deployment: $48k across GOOG, MU, LRCX, LITE and WMT; retain ~$2k cash for flexibility. Through Dec 31 GOOG rose from 243.55 Sept 30 to 313.80; MU 167.32 to 285.41; LRCX 133.90 to 171.18; LITE 162.71 to 368.59. WMT provides a lower-volatility consumer counterweight (103.06 to 111.41). Semis and optical are correlated and volatile, so positions are capped and diversified. Reconsider if their medium-term trends break, GOOG/WMT weaken substantially, or new deposits permit rebalancing; don't assume today's open or close.

Hold the five positions and $2,000 cash, one session after initial deployment. Jan 2 closes: MU 315.42 (+10.5% vs Dec 31), LRCX 185.06 (+8.1%), LITE 386.11 (+4.8%), GOOG 315.32 and WMT 112.76; no medium-term breakdown warrants turnover. Semiconductor/optical concentration remains a risk; review on trend breaks or next deposit, rather than chase a single strong session. Today's opening price is unknown.

Hold five positions and $2,000 cash. Through Jan 5, MU closed 312.15 (vs 315.42 Jan 2), LRCX 194.76 (vs 185.06), GOOG 317.32, WMT 112.71. LITE fell from 386.11 to 357.05 on elevated 5.79m volume, a warning but still above its Dec 17 low of 315 and Nov levels; avoid reacting to one volatile session. Semiconductor/optical exposure is concentrated. Reconsider LITE if weakness persists toward 320 or peers also reverse, and reassess allocations at next deposit. Today's open is unknown.

Hold five positions and $2,000 cash. Jan 6 closes show MU 343.43 (+10.0%), LRCX 206.96 (+6.3%), and LITE 397.42 (+11.3%, recovering Jan 5's drop), all on strong volume; GOOG 314.55 and WMT 114.34 remain steady. These moves support the existing trend, but semiconductors/optics now dominate risk, so avoid adding after sharp advances. Reconsider on sustained reversal (especially LITE below ~340, MU below ~310 or LRCX below ~185), or at the next deposit. Today's open is unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, LITE and WMT with $2,000 cash. Jan 7 closes: GOOG 322.43 strengthened; MU 339.55 and LRCX 203.08 eased modestly after Jan 6 surges; LITE 392.88 held most of its rebound despite a wide daily range; WMT 112.72 remains stable. No sustained trend break, and adding to concentrated semiconductor/optics exposure after rapid gains is unattractive. Reconsider if LITE loses ~340, MU ~310 or LRCX ~185 on sustained weakness, or at next deposit. Today's open is unknown.

Exit LITE and redeploy $8,000 to AMZN, keeping roughly $2,000 cash assuming ordinary opening moves. LITE closed 348.26 on Jan 8, down 11.4% from 392.88, on 5.14m volume; its second abrupt selloff this week and rejection near 395 undermine the prior rebound, while existing MU/LRCX retain ample cyclical exposure. AMZN closed 246.29, above its late-December ~232 range and rising four sessions, offering a different growth driver. Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT. Reconsider AMZN on sustained loss of ~232, MU below ~310, LRCX below ~185; revisit broader exposure at next deposit. Opening prices unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash. Jan 9 closes show LRCX breaking to 218.36 (+8.7% on 16.76m shares), MU rebounding to 345.09, GOOG reaching 329.14, AMZN continuing to 247.38, and WMT recovering to 114.53. Trends remain intact, but MU and LRCX together account for ~47% of equity, so do not chase their sharp gains. Reconsider if MU closes persistently below ~310, LRCX below ~195, AMZN below ~232, or GOOG below ~310; reassess allocations with the next deposit. Today's opening prices unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash. Jan 12 closes: GOOG 332.73, MU 345.87, LRCX 220.40, WMT 117.97 on elevated 49.18m volume, AMZN 246.47. All remain above recent breakout areas, and WMT's strength adds diversification. MU and LRCX are ~47% of holdings, so avoid adding after their rapid run. Reconsider if MU persistently falls below ~310, LRCX ~195, AMZN ~232 or GOOG ~310, or if WMT reverses below ~111; revisit weights at next deposit. Today's open unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; keep $1,930.62 cash. Jan 13 closes: GOOG 336.43 and WMT 120.36 advanced, while MU 338.13, LRCX 214.38 and AMZN 242.60 pulled back modestly. All five remain above their recent breakout/support zones; MU and LRCX already represent ~46% of account value, so avoid increasing semiconductor concentration. Reconsider on sustained closes below MU ~310, LRCX ~195, AMZN ~232, GOOG ~310 or WMT ~111; revisit allocations at the next deposit. Today's opening prices are unknown.

Hold all five positions and $1,930.62 cash. Jan 14 closes: GOOG 336.31 and WMT 120.04 held near recent highs; MU 333.35, LRCX 208.79, AMZN 236.65 retreated again but remain above the previously identified support areas. Semiconductors are already ~46% of total value, so avoid adding on this pullback. Reconsider if MU sustains below ~310, LRCX below ~195, AMZN below ~232, GOOG below ~310 or WMT below ~111; reassess sizing at next deposit. Today's open is unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash. Jan 15 closes: GOOG 333.16, MU 336.63, LRCX 217.47, WMT 119.20, AMZN 238.18. LRCX rebounded with semiconductor-equipment peers but faded sharply from its 228.15 open; MU and LRCX already total ~46% of account, so do not chase. Other positions remain above recent support. Reconsider on sustained closes below MU ~310, LRCX ~195, AMZN ~232, GOOG ~310 or WMT ~111; reassess concentration on next deposit. Today's open unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash. Jan 16 closes: MU 362.75 (+7.8%) on elevated volume and LRCX 222.96 (+2.5%), with AMAT/KLAC also advancing; GOOG 330.34, WMT 119.70 and AMZN 239.12 remain above their recent support. MU and LRCX now make up ~48% of account, so avoid chasing the semiconductor rally. Reconsider on sustained closes below MU ~310, LRCX ~195, AMZN ~232, GOOG ~310 or WMT ~111; review concentration on the next deposit. Today's open is unknown.

Hold all five positions and $1,930.62 cash. Jan 20: MU 365 after touching 381.56 on high volume, LRCX 222.41; semiconductor positions are ~48% of account, so avoid adding. GOOG fell to 322.16 and AMZN to 231, its first close slightly below the ~232 watch level; one weak session does not yet establish a sustained breakdown. WMT held 118.71. Reconsider AMZN if it stays below ~232 or drops toward 225; review GOOG below ~310, MU below ~310, LRCX below ~195 and WMT below ~111. Reassess concentration when the next deposit arrives. Today's opening price is unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash. Jan 21: MU broke higher to 389.11 on heavy volume and LRCX reached 228.39; together they are ~49% of account, so avoid adding despite strong momentum. GOOG recovered to 328.38 and WMT to 119.36. AMZN remains weak at 231.31, a second close below ~232, but bounced from 226.88 intraday; defer selling on this marginal break. Reconsider AMZN on a close below ~225 or continued failure to recover 232; reassess MU/LRCX concentration if momentum reverses or when next month's deposit arrives. Today's open is unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; keep $1,930.62 cash. Jan 22: MU advanced to 397.58 on substantial volume, while LRCX fell to 220.70 after opening at 235.56; AMAT and KLAC also declined, suggesting a sector-wide equipment pullback rather than an isolated breakdown. MU/LRCX represent ~49% of equity, so do not add. AMZN recovered above the ~232 watch level to 234.34; GOOG 330.84 and WMT 117.83 remain constructive. Reconsider equipment exposure on sustained weakness below LRCX ~208-210, MU if it reverses below ~360, AMZN below ~225, and review concentration when February cash arrives. Today's open is unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash. Jan 23: MU closed 399.65 after reaching 412.43, while LRCX eased to 217.94 but remained above the 208–210 watch area; AMAT and KLAC rebounded modestly. AMZN recovered to 239.16; GOOG 328.43 and WMT 117.73 are stable. MU and LRCX together are ~49% of account, so avoid adding into concentration. Reconsider LRCX on sustained closes below ~208–210, MU below ~360, AMZN below ~225, GOOG below ~310, or WMT below ~111; reassess allocations with February's deposit. Today's open is unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash pending February deposit. Jan 26 closes: MU 389.09 pulled back from 399.65 but remains above ~360; LRCX recovered to 222.87, above the 208–210 watch zone, with KLAC also strengthening. GOOG 333.59, WMT 117.64 and AMZN 238.42 remain above their respective watch levels. MU and LRCX are ~49% of account, so avoid adding to semiconductor concentration. Reconsider if MU closes below ~360, LRCX sustains below ~208–210, AMZN below ~225, GOOG below ~310, or WMT below ~111; revisit diversification with February cash. Today's open is unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; keep $1,930.62 cash ahead of February funding. Jan 27 closes: MU 410.24 (+5.4%) and LRCX 238.46 (+7.0%) broke above recent levels, with AMAT and KLAC also strong; GOOG 335 and AMZN 244.68 remain firm. WMT eased to 116.94 but is above its ~111 watch area. MU/LRCX comprise ~50% of account; do not add into the rapid semiconductor rally. Reconsider if MU closes below ~360, LRCX below ~208–210, AMZN below ~225, GOOG below ~310 or WMT below ~111; reassess diversification with February deposit. Today's open unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; retain $1,930.62 cash ahead of February funding. Jan 28 MU surged to 435.28 on 42.7m shares, extending its breakout; LRCX held 239.58 after Jan 27's jump, while AMAT and KLAC also advanced. MU alone is ~30% and MU/LRCX ~51% of account: do not add to semiconductor concentration, but keep the winning trend while it holds. GOOG 336.28, AMZN 243.01 and WMT 116.57 remain above watch zones. Reconsider trimming MU on a reversal through ~399–410, LRCX on closes below ~220, and reassess diversification when February cash arrives; revisit GOOG below ~310, AMZN below ~225, WMT below ~111. Today's open unknown.

Hold GOOG, MU, LRCX, WMT and AMZN; leave $1,930.62 cash until February funding. Jan 29 MU closed 435.79 after a wide 417.70–444.71 range; LRCX rose to 248.17, with AMAT 341.34 and KLAC 1684.71 confirming semiconductor strength. MU/LRCX now ~51% of account, so avoid adding, but neither has broken its trend. GOOG 338.66, AMZN 241.73 and WMT 117.41 remain above watch levels. Reconsider trimming MU if it closes below ~399–410 or LRCX below ~220; revisit GOOG below ~310, AMZN below ~225, WMT below ~111. Reassess diversification with February deposit. Today's opening price is unknown.

Deploy $40,000 of February funding across GILD, META, BKR, GOOG and WMT; retain roughly $11,931 cash. GILD's Jan 30 close of 141.95 extends its January breakout, BKR 56.04 remains above its early-January base, META 716.50 holds most of Jan 29's high-volume jump, GOOG 338.53 stays near January highs, and WMT rebounded to 119.14. These additions diversify existing semiconductor holdings. Hold MU 414.88 and LRCX 233.46 despite Jan 30's volatile semiconductor reversal; do not add to either. Reconsider MU on closes below ~399–410, LRCX below ~220, GILD below ~130, BKR below ~51, META below ~660, GOOG below ~310, or WMT below ~111; review AMZN below ~225. Today's opening prices are unknown.

Hold all eight positions and $11,930.62 cash after yesterday's $40,000 deployment. Feb 2 closes: GOOG 344.90 broke above January highs, MU 437.80 rebounded from Friday's selloff, LRCX 237.50 stayed above 220, WMT 124.06 rose strongly, GILD 142.89 and BKR 56.45 preserved uptrends. META 706.41 retraced its Jan 29 surge but remains above 660; AMZN 242.96 remains above 225. KLAC's decline to 1410.45 cautions against adding semiconductor exposure. Keep cash for better setups rather than chase a single-day jump. Reconsider on closes MU below 399–410, LRCX below 220, GOOG below 310, WMT below 111, GILD below 130, BKR below 51, META below 660, or AMZN below 225; reassess semiconductor breadth. Today's open unknown.

Hold eight positions and $11,930.62 cash. Feb 3 closed with MU 419.44 and LRCX 230.10 weaker but still above 399–410 and 220 watch zones; KLAC 1355.54 and AMAT 318.67 confirm semiconductor pressure, so avoid new exposure. GOOG 340.70, AMZN 238.62 and META 691.70 retreated, while WMT 127.71, GILD 143.28 and BKR 58.00 advanced and diversify the portfolio. Cash is preferable to chasing recent jumps in WMT, CSCO or PEP. Reconsider trimming if MU closes below 399–410, LRCX below 220, META below 660, GOOG below 310, AMZN below 225, WMT below 111, GILD below 130 or BKR below 51; deploy cash on a more stable confirmed setup. Today's opening prices unknown.

Sell MU and LRCX: Feb 4 closes of 379.40 and 209.78 broke the previously stated 399–410 and 220 watch zones on heavy volume; KLAC 1307.22 and AMAT 297.60 also weakened, confirming broad semiconductor pressure. Keep remaining six holdings: GOOG 333.34 and AMZN 232.99 are above their 310/225 review levels; META 668.99 is close to its 660 threshold, so monitor closely. WMT 128, GILD 146.23 and BKR 59.17 remain strong. Preserve sale proceeds plus existing cash rather than immediately rotate into extended defensive names. Reconsider META if it closes below 660; review GOOG below 310, AMZN below 225, WMT below 111, GILD below 130 and BKR below 51. Re-enter semiconductors only after their selling stabilizes. Today's opening fills are unknown.

Sell AMZN: Feb 5 close 222.69 broke the previously specified 225 review level on more than 103m shares, following several declining sessions. GOOG recovered from an intraday low of 306.92 to close 331.33; META recovered from 653.50 to close 670.21, both above their closing review levels, so retain but monitor. Hold WMT, GILD and BKR; their trends remain positive despite BKR's pullback. Keep proceeds in cash while MSFT/NVDA and semiconductor names remain weak and defensive alternatives look extended. Reconsider GOOG on a close below 310, META below 660, WMT below 111, GILD below 130, BKR below 51; reassess AMZN after it regains 225 with stabilization and broader tech selling abates. Today's opening price is unknown.

Add modest positions in MAR and MDLZ while retaining roughly $32k cash. MAR closed Feb 6 at 333.24, above its January 331.09 high after a steadier advance; MDLZ closed 60.02, near its recent high, with a gentler uptrend. They diversify exposure away from weak megacap technology without chasing the steepest defensive rallies. Hold GOOG (323.10) and META (661.46), though META is only just above the previously stated 660 closing review level; retain stronger WMT (131.18), GILD (152.50) and BKR (58.92). AMZN continued down to 210.32, validating caution; semiconductors rebounded Friday but need more stabilization. Reconsider MAR below 315, MDLZ below 57, GOOG below 310, META on a close below 660, WMT below 111, GILD below 130 or BKR below 51. Today's opening fills are unknown.

Deploy $15k of $32.1k cash across CSCO, CSX and ROST; leave approximately $17k reserved. At Feb 9 close CSCO 86.78 reached a January–February high after advancing from 78.32 on Jan 30; CSX 40.72 continued its orderly advance from 37.76; ROST 194.50 recovered above its January closing highs. Smaller allocations temper the risk of buying after rallies and diversify the seven existing positions. Retain GOOG, META, WMT, GILD, BKR, MAR and MDLZ: their Feb 9 closes remain above prior review levels despite WMT's pullback. Reconsider CSCO on a close below 80, CSX below 38, ROST below 185; retain prior review levels of GOOG 310, META 660, WMT 111, GILD 130, BKR 51, MAR 315 and MDLZ 57. Reassess if wider market weakness resumes. Opening fills remain unknown.

Hold ten positions and $17.1k cash. Feb 10 closes show GOOG 318.63 drifting toward the 310 review level, META 670.72 near 660, WMT 126.70 and GILD 147.23 pulling back from recent highs; MAR jumped to 359.35 on elevated volume, while CSX 40.90, BKR 59.15 and MDLZ 60.65 retain uptrends. Avoid adding after mixed price action; AMZN 206.96 remains weak and semiconductor rebounds are uneven. Reconsider GOOG below 310, META below 660, WMT below 111, GILD below 130, BKR below 51, MAR below 315, MDLZ below 57, CSCO below 80, CSX below 38 or ROST below 185 on a close. Reassess cash deployment if broad strength stabilizes. Today's opening fills/prices are unknown.

Hold ten positions and $17.1k cash. Feb 11 closes: GOOG 311.33 is just above its 310 review level after a sustained slide; META 668.69 remains above 660. WMT recovered to 128.77, GILD rebounded to 155.80, BKR reached 61.25, and CSX advanced to 41.34. MDLZ also made a recent high; CSCO and ROST softened without breaking their review levels. Despite semiconductor rebounds, AMZN and MSFT continue declining, so reserve cash rather than adding to mixed conditions. Reconsider GOOG below 310, META below 660, WMT below 111, GILD below 130, BKR below 51, MAR below 315, MDLZ below 57, CSCO below 80, CSX below 38 or ROST below 185 on a close; reconsider deploying cash on steadier broad strength. Today's open is unknown.

Exit GOOG, META and CSCO after their Feb 12 closes breached previously recorded review levels. GOOG 309.37 fell below 310 amid a sustained decline from 344.90 on Feb 2; META 649.81 fell below 660, extending its retreat from the Jan 29 spike; CSCO 75.00 plunged below 80 on unusually heavy volume (68.1m versus 34.5m the prior day). Retain WMT, GILD, BKR, MAR, MDLZ, CSX and ROST: each remains above its review level. Keep proceeds as cash rather than chase yesterday's WMT rally during mixed large-cap action. Reconsider remaining positions after closes below WMT 111, GILD 130, BKR 51, MAR 315, MDLZ 57, CSX 38 or ROST 185, and redeploy cash if sustained strength emerges. Today's opening prices are unknown.

Deploy $17k of $46.6k cash into three relatively steady, strengthening names while retaining about $29.6k reserve amid continued weakness in GOOG, META, AMZN and MSFT. Through Feb 13, AEP closed 129.94 after rising from 121.23 Feb 10, CCEP reached 99.51 on rising volume, and XEL reached 81.59 after clearing its January range. Existing WMT, GILD, BKR, MAR, MDLZ, CSX and ROST remain above recorded review levels; hold them. Reconsider new buys on closes below AEP 122, CCEP 95 or XEL 77; reconsider existing holdings below WMT 111, GILD 130, BKR 51, MAR 315, MDLZ 57, CSX 38 or ROST 185. Reassess reserve when broader weakness stabilizes. Today's opens are unknown.

Add $5k LIN for industrial diversification: Feb 17 close 482.22 versus 460.16 Feb 2, holding near recent highs while megacap software/internet names remain weak. Keep roughly $24.6k cash rather than chase semiconductors or expand utilities after their recent surge. Hold existing ten positions: Feb 17 closes remain above prior review levels, though WMT 128.85 and MDLZ 59.86 pulled back sharply. Reconsider LIN on a close below 460; review existing holdings below WMT 111, GILD 130, BKR 51, MAR 315, MDLZ 57, CSX 38, ROST 185, AEP 122, CCEP 95 or XEL 77. Today's open is unknown.

Buy $5k AMAT to add a modest semiconductor-equipment position: its Feb 18 close of 369.30 rose from 297.60 on Feb 4, and it has held above the Feb 13 high-volume rebound close of 354.91. Limit exposure to roughly 5% of account because the swings are large; retain about $19.6k cash. Hold all 11 existing positions; none crossed its recorded close-based review level, although WMT fell to 126.62 from 133.89 on Feb 13 and AEP/XEL pulled back. Reconsider AMAT on a close below 328; review LIN below 460, WMT 111, GILD 130, BKR 51, MAR 315, MDLZ 57, CSX 38, ROST 185, AEP 122, CCEP 95 or XEL 77. Today's opening fills are unknown.

Trim 40 WMT shares: it fell from 133.89 on Feb 13 to 124.87 on Feb 19, with Feb 19 volume of 43.0m versus roughly 20–30m in late January. This reduces a 14% position while retaining exposure. Add $4.5k FANG for energy diversification alongside BKR: its Feb 19 close of 174.72 exceeds its Feb 11 close of 169.01 and Jan 22 close of 151.85. Add $3.5k LIN, which closed at a 20-session high of 490.11. Hold remaining positions and roughly $16.6k cash assuming near-prior-close fills; actual opening prices unknown. Reconsider FANG below 164, LIN below 460, and WMT on further high-volume decline below 119; review GILD below 130, BKR 51, MAR 315, MDLZ 57, CSX 38, ROST 185, AEP 122, CCEP 95, XEL 77 and AMAT 328.

Buy $4k ADI and $3k CSX, leaving about $9.5k cash before unknown opening fills. ADI closed Feb 20 at 355.03, above its Feb 11 close of 337.00 and its January highs; cap the new semiconductor exposure near 4% alongside AMAT. CSX closed at 42.31, its highest close in the 35 sessions reviewed, up from 38.39 on Feb 2; the addition brings this position near 8% of account. Hold other positions: WMT continues falling (122.99) but remains above the 119 review level; MDLZ 58.80 remains above 57. Reconsider ADI below 330, CSX below 39, WMT below 119, and previously recorded levels for other holdings; avoid chasing LITE after its unusually steep rise. Opening prices are unknown.

Add $3.5k MNST, keeping roughly $6k cash. Its Feb 23 close of 84.69 exceeded every close in the 22 sessions reviewed, after 83.76 on Feb 20; size the new position at only ~3.4% because this is a short-term breakout. Hold existing diversified positions: WMT rebounded to 125.81 after 122.99, MDLZ to 60.38 after 58.80, while BKR, LIN, CCEP and XEL remain firm. Reconsider MNST on a close below 80; revisit WMT below 119, MDLZ below 57, ADI below 330, CSX below 39, and other previously recorded review levels. Opening fill is unknown.

Hold all positions and $6,049 cash after three recent sessions of additions. Feb 24 closes confirm BKR 64.72, LIN 504, CSX 42.47, AEP 132.39 and MNST 85.54 remain strong; WMT recovered to 126.75 and MDLZ to 61.13. GILD eased to 147.64 and MAR to 343.15, but neither has breached its prior review level. Avoid raising already broad semiconductor exposure or chasing additional consumer names. Reconsider if GILD closes below 130, MAR below 315, WMT below 119, MNST below 80, or other previously recorded levels break; evaluate fresh allocations when the next deposit arrives. Today's open remains unknown.

Hold 15 positions and $6,063 cash. Feb 25 closes: LIN 508.27, AMAT 394.95, CCEP 108.24 and ADI 360.80 support existing uptrends; FANG slipped to 167.77 from 176.01 on Feb 20 but remains above the recorded 164 review level. GILD 147.12 and MAR 347.44 remain above their review levels; WMT 125.75 is above 119. Avoid adding to 15-name exposure immediately before the next monthly deposit. Reconsider FANG on a close below 164, WMT below 119, GILD below 130, MAR below 315, and other recorded levels; reassess allocations on the next deposit. Today's opening prices are unknown.

Hold 15 positions and $6,091 cash ahead of the next monthly deposit. Feb 26 closes: GILD fell to 143.77 from 155.27 on Feb 17 and WMT to 124.42 from 133.89 on Feb 13, but both remain above prior review levels (130 and 119). AMAT pulled back 4.9% to 375.72 after a sharp advance, still above its Feb 20 close of 375.38; avoid adding to semiconductors on that volatility. BKR 64.90, CSX 42.65, CCEP 108.35, and MNST 86.66 remain firm. Reassess allocations when the March deposit arrives; review GILD sooner if it continues below 140, AMAT if it closes below 360, FANG below 164, and existing position thresholds if breached. Today's opening prices are unknown.

Allocate $44,000 of the March deposit across six new positions (AMGN, PEP, COST, EXC, FER, TMUS) and add modestly to established BKR, CSX, CCEP trends; retain about $12,091 cash for volatility. Feb 27 closes show AMGN 388.16, COST 1010.79, EXC 49.47 and FER 74.38 near recent highs; PEP 169.74 and TMUS 217.09 remain above January levels. BKR 65.26, CSX 42.69 and CCEP 110.43 maintain strong advances. Avoid adding to semiconductors or weakening mega-cap technology after NVDA's decline to 177.19. Review new positions if closes fall below AMGN 365, PEP 160, COST 960, EXC 46, FER 70 or TMUS 202; reevaluate BKR below 60, CSX below 40 and CCEP below 103, and existing positions at previously recorded levels. Opening fills and today's close are unknown.

Hold 21 positions and $12,103 cash following yesterday's March-deposit deployment. Mar 2 closes keep BKR 64.83, CSX 43.17, LIN 509.34, AEP 133.29 and XEL 83.80 in their recent uptrends. MNST fell to 81.06 from 86.66 on Feb 26 and MAR gapped down to 330.47; avoid adding to either, but both remain above recorded review levels (MNST 80, MAR 315). No new allocation one session after adding nine positions. Reconsider on closes below those levels, AMAT 360, CCEP 103, GILD 130, or other previously recorded thresholds. Today's open and close are unknown.

Reduce risk after March 3 weakness: sell MNST (78.99, below 80 review level after falling from 86.66 on Feb 26), AMAT (351.32, below 360 after a sharp semiconductor reversal), and FER (68.83, below 70 following a pronounced gap lower). Sell full positions using recorded units; today's open is unknown. Keep proceeds and existing $12,103 cash rather than add into a broad pullback. Retain remaining holdings while monitoring CCEP below 103, BKR below 60, MAR below 315, GILD below 130, and other prior review levels. Reconsider purchases if trends stabilize over multiple closes; reassess additional sales on confirmed breaks.

Put $9,000 of $25,176 cash into modest, diversified technology exposure; retain roughly $16,176 cash given weakness in several existing positions. META closed 667.73 on Mar 4, up from 637.25 on Feb 23 and higher through the March 3 pullback; CSCO closed 80.87, recovering from 75 on Feb 12 and above its recent 77–79 range. Neither purchase depends on a known opening price. BKR has declined three sessions to 60.88 and CCEP to 104.53: avoid adding to either and reassess if they close below 60 and 103 respectively. Reconsider META below 630 or CSCO below 76, or if market weakness broadens; today's open and close remain unknown.

Sell CCEP and ADI after their Mar 5 closes breached recorded review levels. CCEP closed 101.68 below 103, down from 110.43 Feb 27; ADI closed 329.72 below 330, down from 360.80 Feb 25. Broad weakness across WMT, LIN, CSX, PEP and AMGN argues against immediately recycling proceeds; retain the other positions and roughly $27.7k cash at prior-close estimates. BKR is near its 60 review level at 60.19; PEP 160.70 and AMGN 367.60 remain just above their respective 160 and 365 levels. Reconsider further reductions if those levels break on closing prices, and buying only after trends stabilize. Today's opening fills and close are unknown.

Reduce BKR, PEP and CSX after Mar 6 closes slipped below the previously recorded review levels: BKR 59.81 <60 (65.26 Feb 27), PEP 159.43 <160 (169.74 Feb 27), CSX 39.95 <40 (43.17 Mar 2). Sell full recorded units at unknown opening prices; preserve proceeds and existing $27,559 cash rather than buy into several falling trends. Hold other positions: AMGN 369.53 remains above 365, MAR 323.80 above 315, WMT 123.80 above 119 and MDLZ 58.40 above 57. Reconsider remaining holdings if these closing thresholds break; redeploy cash after broader stabilization over multiple closes. Today's fills and closing valuation remain unknown.

Deploy $15k of $55,956 cash in three diversified technology positions, retaining about $41k cash given recent broad volatility. CRWD closed 434.13 Mar 9, rising across six sessions from 384.86 Mar 2; NFLX closed 98.32, holding most of its Feb 27 breakout from 84.59 Feb 26; MSFT closed 409.41, recovering from 384.47 Feb 23 and staying above 400 for five sessions. Avoid chasing sharper two-day semiconductor moves. Existing WMT 124.34 >119, MAR 328.86 >315, AMGN 376.97 >365, MDLZ 58.17 >57, and CSCO 76.21 narrowly >76: retain but review CSCO below 76, and the other recorded levels on future closes. Reassess new buys if CRWD closes below 400, NFLX below 93, or MSFT below 395. Today's opening fills and closing values are unknown.
